subject: note: The wish of a terminally ill person is very often not so much happiness as death with dignity, without feeling they have acted illegally or immorally. Hume argues that suicide ‘may be free from imputation of guilt and blame’.
note: As paradoxical as it might sound, the decision to end one’s life is a requirement of life in order to escape a life of indignity and incarceration, the life of the concentration camp.
